summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Banco BBVA Argentina S.A. reporting a routine cash dividend payment. The board resolved at the April 28, 2026 shareholders meeting, with BCRA authorization on May 15, 2026, to pay the third installment of $23,003,675,041 total ($37.5441433549 per share, 3754% of capital stock). Record date is August 3, 2026; payment date August 6, 2026. Holders of ADSs will receive payment through BNY Mellon under applicable rules. The filing contains no merger, acquisition, tender offer, or strategic event; it is a standard dividend distribution notice. What to watch: none; this is a routine corporate action.
